fluff.overview: Drawing veterans from the Com Guards, recruits from the Free Worlds League, and volunteers from Protectorate worlds, the Word of Blake Militia assembled infantry formations whose quality varied but whose equipment was consistently first-rate. Mechanized tracked Level I formations rode APCs that could keep pace with armor across broken terrain, providing the all-terrain mobility and armor protection that garrison duty on undeveloped worlds demanded. The tracked transport kept these troops mobile even on worlds where roads were poor or nonexistent. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
